tcp_port.description: Port for ADB to listen on in TCP mode (if enabled).

usb_enabled.description: Whether ADB over USB is enabled.

tcp_enabled.description: Whether ADB over TCP/network is enabled.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous ADB connections (USB + TCP). Some implementations ignore this.

adb_auth_key.description: Path to the private key file used for secure ADB authentication (if supported).

adb_server_port.description: Port used by the ADB host server (not always honored by adbd itself).

trusted_hosts.description: List of trusted IPs or hostnames allowed to connect in TCP mode. Empty means allow all.

shell_timeout_ms.description: Timeout (in milliseconds) for ADB shell commands.

adb_secure.description: Whether to enforce secure ADB mode (requires key-based auth).

adb_tmp_dir.description: Working directory for temporary ADB files.

usb_product_ids.description: Comma-separated hex product IDs (e.g., ['0x1234']) to restrict USB ADB to specific devices.

no_auto_start.description: If true, adbd will not auto-start at boot — useful for manual control.
